data.one_liner: 3D flip-panel widgets for countdowns, clocks, and custom digits
data.what_it_does: Provides animated 3D flip panels for countdown timers, flip clocks, and arbitrary widgets, with customizable styles and server‑driven timing.
use_when: Need a visually appealing countdown or clock
Want to avoid drift and background issues
avoid_when: You need a simple numeric countdown without animation
strengths: Accurate timing with monotonic and wall clocks
No external dependencies beyond flutter and clock
